highlights: Major platforms are enhancing their agent-building capabilities, with Google releasing advanced Gemini API features and NVIDIA launching a PyTorch-native agentic RL framework.

The LLM and multimodal model landscape continues to diversify with AMD's open MoE LLM and MiniMax's omni-modal video generation model, alongside critical price-performance advancements in OpenAI's GPT-5.6.
New open-source tools like Supabase Evals and JetBrains KotlinLLM are empowering developers with better evaluation and productivity for AI-driven coding.

agents.title: Gemini API Managed Agents: 3.6 Flash, hooks, and more
agents.summary: Google enhances its Gemini API with Managed Agents 3.6 Flash, new hooks, and capabilities for developers to build more reliable and production-ready AI agents.

agents.title: DeepSeek Upgrades DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 with Major Agentic and Coding Gains
agents.summary: DeepSeek has re-post-trained its V4-Flash-0731 model, delivering significant improvements in agentic reasoning and coding capabilities without changing the underlying architecture.

agents.title: Scientific computing in the age of agentic AI
agents.summary: OpenAI highlights how AI coding agents are revolutionizing scientific computing, accelerating software development and discovery in fields like genomics.

models.title: AMD Releases Instella-MoE-16B-A3B: A Fully Open Mixture-of-Experts LLM With 2.8B Active Parameters Trained On Instinct GPUs
models.summary: AMD has launched Instella-MoE-16B-A3B, a fully open Mixture-of-Experts LLM with 2.8B active parameters, trained on their Instinct GPUs, and released all training artifacts.

models.title: MiniMax Releases MiniMax H3: An Omni-Modal Video Model That Generates 15-Second 2K Clips With Native Stereo Audio
models.summary: MiniMax introduced H3, an omni-modal video generation model capable of producing 15-second 2K clips with native stereo audio from unified text, image, video, and audio contexts.

models.title: Advancing the price-performance frontier with GPT-5.6
models.summary: OpenAI has lowered pricing for GPT-5.6 (Luna and Terra), optimizing models for greater efficiency to help enterprises deploy AI workflows at scale.

tools.title: NVIDIA AI Releases Molt: A PyTorch-Native Agentic Reinforcement Learning Framework
tools.summary: NVIDIA AI introduced Molt, a PyTorch-native agentic reinforcement learning framework designed to simplify algorithm modification and streamline distributed training workflows.

tools.title: Supabase Releases Evals: an Open Source Benchmark That Scores Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode on Real Supabase Tasks
tools.summary: Supabase open-sourced Evals, an Apache-2.0 benchmark and framework that evaluates coding agents against real-world Supabase tasks within containerized environments.

tools.title: JetBrains Open-Sources KotlinLLM: Smart Macros That Generate Kotlin Source Code at Runtime and Hot-Reload It Through JDI
tools.summary: JetBrains Research released KotlinLLM, an IntelliJ plugin that uses LLM-powered smart macros to generate and hot-reload Kotlin source code at runtime via JDI.

companies.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with ChatGPT for Academic Researchers
companies.summary: OpenAI is granting 100,000 academic researchers free access to its most advanced ChatGPT models to accelerate scientific research and foster collaboration.

companies.title: Disrupting a Criminal Scam Operation
companies.summary: OpenAI successfully disrupted a Cambodia-based criminal scam operation that was misusing ChatGPT for investment, romance, gambling, and impersonation schemes.

companies.title: Anatomy of a Frontier Lab Agent Intrusion: A Technical Timeline of the July 2026 Incident
companies.summary: Hugging Face disclosed a detailed technical timeline of a July 2026 security incident involving a Frontier Lab Agent intrusion, emphasizing transparency in AI security.

learning.title: Accelerating Transformer Training with NVIDIA Transformer Engine, Fused Kernels, BF16, FP8, and GPU Benchmarking
learning.summary: This tutorial guides users through optimizing transformer workloads using NVIDIA Transformer Engine, implementing FP8 delayed scaling, and benchmarking model performance in PyTorch.

learning.title: End-to-End Forecasting with TimesFM 2.5: Backtesting, Covariates, Anomaly Detection, and Scalable Colab Deployment
learning.summary: A comprehensive tutorial demonstrating an end-to-end time-series forecasting workflow using TimesFM 2.5, covering data generation, model compilation, backtesting, and anomaly detection.

learning.title: Profiling in PyTorch (Part 3): Attention is all you profile
learning.summary: The third part of a PyTorch profiling series, this article delves into optimizing attention mechanisms, a critical component for improving performance in transformer models.
